subject: Physical AI Panel - Apr 15 - Nuro & Phantom AI coming
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about your work on perception and localisation at
Kodiak. On the timely topic of AI in the physical world, we're hosting an
intimate Physical AI event with Next47 on Tuesday April 15th at AWS Loft in
SF (capping attendance at 40). We'd love for you to join if you're in town!

The event will run from 5:30 to 8:30pm, opening with a panel featuring
CxOs/Heads of AI from Skydio, Intrinsic, Archetype AI & our Co-Founder
[SENDER], moderated by Colton Dempsey (Partner @Next47) Will discuss trends in
robotics & autonomous systems: technical innovations, scaling challenges,
and investment opportunities etc.

Following the panel, we've planned an informal networking session with
refreshments --joined by technical leaders from Nuro, Phantom AI, Latitude
AI, Plus, etc.

Bit of context on Encord…we're a computer vision scale-up (Series B, $50M
raised) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation, and model
evaluation in one platform.

Let me know if you're around and I can send over the full details!

subject: Working w/ GV portfolio Co's (Synthesia, Viz.ai, Zipline)
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

My team just flagged to me that [COMPANY] is a Google ventures portfolio company, so thought I'd reach out. I lead a computer vision research team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) - we're actually working with a few GV portfolio companies (Synthesia, Viz.ai, Zipline) & Israeli teams like Pixellot.

I've been following [COMPANY] for a while now - especially the focus on multimodal AI (video + sound) - which we're also heavily investing in, so keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: [Invite] Encord Physical AI Dinner @ Harvard Club Boston
text:

subject: Met Margaret & Victoria | Working w/ Captions & Synthesia
text:
